about: Reviewed reference frames of the breengel suite (docs/gui/breengel.md section 8.6). Each is rendered by tools/gfx-refgen from the guest's own no_std libgfx and libfont on the host at authoring time and reviewed before it is committed. The guest reads them from /usr/local/test/share/breengel/frames/. Frames saved from runs never become references.

references.scene: DejaVu Sans Mono "Hg" at 16 px, white, pen at (8, 6) on 48 x 32 black
references.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (breengel raster lane), from the rendered frames enlarged 4x
references.checked: Both glyphs legible with anti-aliased edges; the g descender below the baseline; nothing clipped.

references.scene: DejaVu Sans "Breenix" at 8, 12, 16, 24 and 48 px, pens at x 4 and y 2, 14, 30, 52 and 86, white on 256 x 160 black
references.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (breengel raster lane), from the rendered frames enlarged 4x
references.checked: Five lines in ascending size, none overlapping or clipped; at 8 px the unhinted 26.6 layout leaves a visibly wider n-i gap, as section 8.3 rounding gives.

references.scene: DejaVu Sans "Subpixel LCD" at 16 px with LCD rendering, white, pen at (4, 4) on 160 x 28 black
references.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (breengel raster lane), from the rendered frames enlarged 4x
references.checked: Legible text with per-channel colour fringes on the left and right edges of stems, as horizontal RGB striping gives.

references.scene: testdata/breengel/fonts/compound-transform.ttf "BA" at 48 px, white, pen at (4, 8) on 200 x 64 black
references.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (breengel raster lane), from the rendered frames enlarged 4x
references.checked: 'B' is the F with its round bowl; 'A' shows it at half scale, stretched by (1.5, 0.75) with the bowl flattened, and rotated 30 degrees counter-clockwise, each at its component offset.

references.scene: SHA-256 of U+0021 to U+007E of DejaVu Sans Mono then DejaVu Sans at 7, 12, 16, 23.5 and 40 px, then both fonts with LCD rendering at 16 px; per glyph: width and height (u32), x and y offsets (i32), little-endian, then the coverage bytes
references.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (breengel raster lane), from the rendered frames enlarged 4x
references.checked: The hash of the glyph set the reviewed frames are drawn from; the guest recomputes it on every target.

references.scene: BreenGL section 16.1 literal 640x512 scene: Home, Search, Save, Arrow Forward; Idle, HoverIn, Hovering, Pressed, Clicked; size 48 centered at (64+128*column,64+128*row), background (12,19,31).
references.reviewer: GPT-6.1 Sol, inspected the generated 640x512 image before pinning
references.checked: All twenty cells contain the named icon at the specified center; roofs and doors, glass and handles, solid disks and slots, forward arrows are legible. Clicked cells show the door highlight, expanding sonar, inserted disk and trail; effects stay within their cells. The guest uses independent schedule code and reads this immutable file.
